user.title: Floorplan Studio
user.description: Adds the Floorplan editor to the sidebar and the floorplan card to your dashboards. Open **Floorplan** in the sidebar afterwards to draw or import your home.

init.title: Floorplan Studio
init.description: Choose whether the Floorplan editor is in the sidebar. The floorplan card on your dashboards always keeps working. Hidden? Then open the editor at the address /floorplan-studio.

place_device.name: Place a device
place_device.description: Moves a device on the floorplan to a spot described in plain words (also used by AI assistants).

device.name: Device
device.description: Name or entity id of the device.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room or area on the floorplan (empty = the room it is in now, or its area).

spot.name: Spot
spot.description: Where in the room, e.g. 'above the dining table', 'next to the sofa', 'left wall', 'top right corner', 'middle'.

height.name: Height
height.description: Metres above the floor (for 2.5D and the walk-through).

mount.name: Mounting
mount.description: Ceiling lamp, hanging lamp, on a wall, on the floor or on a table.

describe.name: Describe the floorplan
describe.description: Returns rooms, furniture and devices with their positions in metres.
